title: small totems
description: more smaller totem for cyristal pvp.
body:
⚡ Small Totem Pack for Crystal PvP ⚡

This custom mini totem pack is made especially for Crystal PvP players who want a cleaner and less distracting screen while fighting. The totem takes up way less space compared to the default one, giving you better visibility during intense fights and helping you focus more on your surroundings, crystals, and enemy movements.

✨ Features:
• Small and clean design
• Doesn’t block your screen
• Perfect for fast-paced Crystal PvP
• Better visibility during fights
• Smooth and minimal look
• Lightweight and simple texture style

If you’re tired of the default huge totem covering your screen, this pack is made for you. Enjoy cleaner gameplay, better focus, and a more competitive PvP experience.
